question:

(A) [0.0276, 0.6935, 0.2476, 0.9135]
(B) [0.0626, 0.0262, 0.2826, 0.2462]
(C) [0.7242, 0.7075, 0.9442, 0.9275]
(D) No region lies inside a mirror.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
